info.title: Sightline
info.description: A live, editable map of your code in C#, TypeScript and JavaScript, also across languages. See projects, packages, types, dependency injection, HTTP endpoints and the flow behind each request in one page that updates while you edit.

x-inspectra.cliParsedTitle: Sightline 0.5.0: a live, editable map of your code, in C#, TypeScript and JavaScript

commands.name: check
commands.description: List problems; exit code 1 when there are errors

options.name: --port
options.description: Port for the map page (default 5210, or the next free one)

options.name: --no-open
options.description: Do not open the browser

options.name: --no-restore
options.description: Do not run "dotnet restore" for C# projects that were never restored

options.name: --version
options.description: Show the version

options.name: --help
options.description:
Show this help
Options for init:

options.name: --solution
options.description: The solution to open, when there are several

options.name: --vscode
options.description: Add the VS Code task even if there is no .vscode folder

options.name: --no-vscode
options.description: Do not add the VS Code task

options.name: --no-tool
options.description:
Do not pin Sightline in the tool manifest
Options for check:

options.name: --format
options.description:
text (default), json, or github (annotations for GitHub Actions)
markdown (default), text, or json

options.name: --fail-on
options.description:
error (default), warning, info, or never
Options for export:
Exit with 1 when the change adds problems: error, warning, or never (default)
For tools:

options.name: --out
options.description:
Write a static website: open index.html, or host the folder anywhere
Write the result to a file instead of the console

options.name: --json
options.description: Write the map as JSON (what "diff" compares)

options.name: --no-source
options.description: Leave the source code out of the website

options.name: --source-url
options.description:
Load source code from this address instead, with {path} for the file,
e.g. https://raw.githubusercontent.com/owner/repo/<commit>/{path}

options.name: --title
options.description:
Title shown on the page
Options for diff:

options.name: --base
options.description:
The git commit, branch or tag to compare with, e.g. origin/main
<base.json> <head.json>  Or compare two files written by "export --json"

options.name: --attach
options.description:
Run beside process <pid>: join the map already open for this
solution, and close 10 seconds after the last such process ends
(used by the Co.Revington.Sightline.Hosting package)

options.name: --ui
options.description: Serve the page from this folder

options.name: --token
options.description:
Use this API token instead of a random one
More at https://sightline.revington.co
